manufacturer_data_needed.required: Guaranteed minimum sensor resistance greater than cold inhibit boundary
Guaranteed maximum sensor resistance less than hot inhibit boundary

limitations: All boundaries inherit the original4.75..5.25V,1% resistor and33mV comparator-error assumptions. This is not a guarantee at actual common-mode, input bias or leakage.
Endpoint criteria apply to sensor temperature only and require monotonic NTC behavior over the applicable range. They do not establish cell temperature or thermal lag margin.
Equality and uncertainty bands must not be called pass; hysteresis direction and actual comparator behavior require validation.
Full R-T information remains useful to establish the actual charge window and thermal margin; endpoint criteria prioritize missing supplier evidence rather than waive qualification.
No component substitution, schematic change or charging enablement.
